title.zh: 加大研发力度 助力行业前行
title.en: Boosting R&D to Drive the Industry Forward

summary.zh: 寅铠持续加大研发投入，以第七代设备引领光伏边框自动化技术升级，助力行业高质量发展。
summary.en: Yinkai keeps increasing R&D investment, leading PV frame automation upgrades with its 7th-generation equipment.

body.zh: 光伏边框自动化设备需求持续升级，寅铠坚持自主研发，不断迭代 YK 系列产品，以更高节拍、更高稳定性回应市场期待。
body.en: Demand for PV frame automation keeps upgrading. Yinkai insists on independent R&D and continuous iteration of the YK series, responding to market expectations with higher takt and higher stability.

body.zh: 第七代（YK-7）设备在尺寸、稳定性、维护成本与操作便捷性上全面优化，第三季度正式上市后获得客户广泛认可。
body.en: The 7th-generation (YK-7) equipment is comprehensively optimized in size, stability, maintenance cost and usability, and has been widely recognized by customers since its Q3 launch.

body.zh: 面向未来，寅铠将继续加大研发力度，与产业链伙伴携手，推动光伏边框行业向全自动无人化工厂转型。
body.en: Looking ahead, Yinkai will continue to increase R&D efforts and work with industry partners to drive the transition toward fully unmanned PV frame factories.

title.zh: 成功研发第七代光伏边框铝材自动生产线
title.en: 7th-Generation Aluminum PV Frame Automatic Line Successfully Developed

summary.zh: YK-7 铝边框自动化设备正式上市：尺寸更小、稳定性更高、维护成本更低、操作更简单。
summary.en: The YK-7 aluminum frame automation line is launched: smaller, more stable, lower maintenance, easier to operate.

body.zh: 寅铠第七代（YK-7）光伏边框铝材自动生产线研发成功并于第三季度正式上市。
body.en: Yinkai's 7th-generation (YK-7) aluminum PV frame automatic production line was successfully developed and officially launched in Q3.

body.zh: 相较上一代，YK-7 设备尺寸更小、稳定性更高，维护保养成本更低，操作更加简单，节拍保持 2 秒以内的行业领先水平。
body.en: Compared with the previous generation, YK-7 is smaller and more stable, with lower maintenance cost and simpler operation, maintaining an industry-leading cycle time under 2 seconds.

body.zh: 同时，自动码垛机升级至第五代，与产线深度联动，为客户提供整线无人化解决方案。
body.en: Meanwhile, the automatic palletizer was upgraded to its 5th generation, deeply integrated with the line to provide customers with full-line unmanned solutions.
